caption: The drawing contains two distinct decorative designs. The top design is an elongated rectangle with a rounded oval section in the center and stepped corners, bordered with lines in shades of brown and tan. Inside the central oval area, there is a detailed composition featuring a bird, possibly a rooster, standing on branches among leaves and flowers, with squirrel-like creatures in the corners of the rectangle within the oval. The central panel is filled with tan, cream, and brown hues, with delicate linework defining the leaves, flowers, and animals. The lower design is a large, downward-pointing triangle with curved upper edges. Within the triangle, there is a large, central flower surrounded by large, overlapping leaves, all rendered in shades of brown and outlined in darker tones. The backgrounds of both designs are tan, and the objects themselves are made up of various brown, ochre, cream, and reddish tones, with details in darker browns and some areas highlighted with lighter shades.
title: Inlaid Wood Panel
